message.content:
I ran an arXiv search for recent “transformer” papers but the top results returned unrelated 2026 submissions (not transformer-method papers). Before I try again, a couple quick questions so I do the right work:

1) Do you want "recent" constrained to a date range (e.g., papers from 2024–2026, last 12 months, or since 2024-01-01)?
2) Do you prefer only architecture/method papers about transformers (e.g., efficient transformers, scaling laws, new attention variants), or also applied transformer work (vision, speech, code, RL)?
3) Which project should I add the papers to? (I can detect and reuse the current project if you're on a project page — otherwise I'll create one if you want.) Note: I won't ingest or add papers until you confirm.

Tell me those preferences and I'll re-run the search, pick the top three matches, ingest them, add them to the project, and give concise summaries.
